name: Chats inbox
author: wizard
description: Chats gets three tabs at the bottom: Inbox (today's Activity list), Tags (today's Channels) and Sent. Sent lists everything you sent, newest first: your words, where it went (Background, Thread, Command, Reminder), whether it is running, done, needs you or failed, and why it went there; a tap opens its thread, and Should have replied / Didn't need a reply fix the routing in one tap. Working is Sent's filter, so the Running row above Ready goes away. Needs the Agent inbox switch (wizard/agent-inbox), which keeps the Sent log on your Wizard (wizard-ux issue 1778, wizard-agent-service issue 607).
